public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\forall int j; 0 - 1 <= j < i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 < k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[k])) && (\forall int j; 0 <= j < k; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))))));  
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 < j <= i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k <= i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ?         //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {

                wordStart = true;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 < j <= i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 < k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ?         //@ decreases n - i;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);

        }

        return ret;
    }

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 < j <= i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 <= k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[k])) && (\exists int j; 0 < j < k; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))))));  
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 < j <= i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 <= k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ?         //@ decreases n - i;

                wordStart = true;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 < j <= i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; 0 - 1 <= k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[k])) && (\exists int j; 0 - 1 <= j < k; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))))));  
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < arr.length; Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);  
    //@ ensures (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) && (\exists int j; 0 - 1 <= j < i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> \result[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))));  
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 < k < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))))));  
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 < k <= i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> (ret[k] == (wordStart ?
